scope: Eight scoped desktop UI cases: real controls, finite command state, preserved checkpoints, controlled player defeat, actual strategic critical-front expiry through the normal main update/end flow and optional evolved-caste selection with signed identities. No natural victory, human comprehension, hardware FPS or source-film fidelity claimed.
historicalHarness: The six prior cases are retained from the November 1 helper. These executions and their source/index pins are new; previous runs remain separate historical evidence.
assistances: Insertion advanced by the existing actual game.update helper at 1/60
Strategic and rendering updates paused between input steps to preserve comparable state
Controlled public update at 1/60 after actual cloak key input
Controlled player HP=0 followed by actual game.update for case 6 only
Case 7 records deaths of existing finite NPC IDs through the simulation owner to isolate the strategic deadline without resetting player HP or inventing units

Case 7 walks the hunter outside the authored front radius through production navigation/floor/capsule/pod collision, with at most 0.7 units per step and 0.66 units of floor correction; the fixture must not let the hunter automatically recapture the front

Case 7 captures the authored critical front for an actual hostile faction, saves/reloads the genuine operation checkpoint and advances the real updateBattleOperation loop until its unchanged deadline expires; no result injection or manual endGame call
Finite CSS transitions completed only for static screenshot capture
